requirement: Real campaign review preserves snapshot groups, image templates, permissions and expiry without sending mail

oracle.invariant: The HTTP handoff imports 1340 recipients with all 43 source cells and five original groups, five image templates and no outbound transport. A supplementary CSV preview expires no later than its campaign and rolls back when the campaign expires or is revoked during persistence. Expiry during extension rolls back and permanently revokes its key; one unavailable vault cannot block other cleanup. Manual to column and back retains source cells and inactive overrides while invalidating approval without overwriting customized text. Authorization is rechecked after a campaign lock wait and after a delayed upload, before private data is read or published. Draft and template editors stay locked through their saved detail refresh, and responses after unmount cannot overwrite another editor. Replacement reaches all 230 recipients only through explicitly confirmed batches; cancellation preserves its cursor. Authenticated managed images fit desktop and mobile; the opaque preview runs no script, form, navigation or third-party request and disappears after revocation.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command
